references.text: The original instruction from God to Moses to make loops of blue purple on the edge of the outermost curtain at each joining. Exodus 36:11 describes the execution of this command.
The instruction to make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the edge of the other curtain in the second joining, so that the loops correspond to each other.
The continuation of the description stating that fifty loops were made on one curtain and fifty loops on the edge of the other curtain, so that the loops were directly opposite each other.
A parallel construction where loops were also made on the edge of the outermost curtain at the joining for the goatskin covering over the tabernacle.
